data.name: Description
data.value: Local environment values, shared across projects and protected for your Windows account. Use references in input fields or pass them to Skills. The AI Assistant can discover references, but cannot read stored values.

data.name: NameHint
data.value: Unique reference name: letters, numbers, underscores and hyphens. Example: LocalMySQLServerUrl.

data.name: ProtectionHint
data.value: All values are encrypted locally, including URLs and other environment settings. Password masking only controls their display here. Other environments need their own Vault entries with matching names.

data.name: InvalidNames
data.value: Each entry needs a unique name containing only letters, numbers, underscores or hyphens.

data.name: SaveError
data.value: The Vault could not be saved. See the application log files for details.

data.name: DiscardChanges
data.value: Discard unsaved Vault changes and close?

data.name: NoSelection
data.value: No entry selected. Select a card to view or edit its details.
